thread:
alex: Heads-up — planning a split rollout for the inference-runtime LRU fix. Target deploy: tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Plan = canary (10% us-west) -> staggered ramp (30m windows) -> full. Need smoke owners, rollback owner, and infra toggle readiness. Keeping it low-risk: no schema changes.

maria: I can be smoke owner for the canary. I'll run the quick e2e + smoke load (happy path + short latency check).

jen: I’ll take rollback ownership. Rollback runbook: 1) flip infra flag runtime_lru_enable=false 2) revert to image sha abc1234 3) drain and restart affected nodes. I’ll be online during window.

sam: Agree on gating metrics — suggestion: errors increase <= 0.5% absolute, p95 latency <= baseline + 100ms, successful requests >= 99%. I'll spin up a short dashboard and alerts.

kevin: Infra toggle is staged and tested in staging; can flip via infra-flag tool. I’ll standby for flag flip and any infra ops.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by request: 2026-06-15T02:00:00Z. Canary 30m, auto-abort on error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > threshold. Will ping #eng-oncall on start/abort/success.

alex: Quick pre-deploy checklist (please ack):
- [ ] CI green
- [ ] Smoke owner assigned (maria)
- [ ] Rollback owner assigned (jen)
- [ ] Dashboard + alerts (sam)
- [ ] Infra toggle ready (kevin)
- [ ] Runbook links in thread

Please reply with :thumbsup: when each is done. Also add any additional tiny risk items.

maria: CI is green and artifacts uploaded. Running a short staging smoke now — will report within 10m. :thumbsup:

jen: Rollback steps documented in the runbook: /runbooks/inference-runtime-rollback — I’ve tested the revert flow in staging. :thumbsup:

sam: Dashboard created: /dashboards/inference/runtime-canary — alerts set for error_rate and p95. Will monitor during window.

kevin: Infra toggle endpoint verified; I’ll be available at T-15m.

alex: Great — tally: CI (maria) ✅, smoke owner (maria) ✅, rollback (jen) ✅, dashboard (sam) ✅, infra (kevin) ✅. If no objections, proceeding with scheduled deploy. I’ll kick off canary and monitor post-30m and then stagger ramp.

maria: No objections from me. I’ll post quick smoke notes after canary start.

jen: I’m on pager and will execute rollback immediately if the abort signal fires.

sam: Will watch dashboards and call abort if thresholds exceeded.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: deploy in 2h.

alex: Thanks everyone — tagging this thread as the official pre-deploy signoff. If anything changes ping here or DM. :rocket:
